presets.name: minimal
presets.description: The hardened API on its own: no sign-in, no database, notes kept in memory, no agent files.

presets.name: saas-api
presets.description: Accounts with Identity on PostgreSQL, confirmation emails over SMTP, durable Hangfire jobs, file storage, CSV, Excel and PDF documents, notifications, webhooks and Claude guidance.

presets.name: api-worker
presets.description: An API that queues jobs and a worker that runs them, on PostgreSQL, started together by an Aspire AppHost.

presets.name: sso-api
presets.description: No local accounts: the API trusts tokens from your OpenID Connect provider, on PostgreSQL, with a dev Keycloak.

presets.name: single-box
presets.description: Everything on one small machine such as a Raspberry Pi: Identity accounts on SQLite, in-process jobs and files in the bundled RustFS.

presets.name: realtime
presets.description: A real-time backend such as a chat: Identity accounts on PostgreSQL, a SignalR hub, server-sent events and WebSockets, in-app and push notifications, and in-process jobs.
